item.title: Accessing a VMware NAT Virtual Machine from Another PC: Networking, SSH Authentication, and Troubleshooting
item.description: This article records how I connected a second Windows computer to a Linux virtual machine running in VMware, including the port conflict and SSH authentication issues I encountered. Both computers are connected to the same home Wi-Fi network. PC1 runs VMware Workstation, and PC2 connects to the VM over SSH. Once SSH works, I use VS Code Remote-SSH for remote development. Prerequisites PC1: Windows with VMware Workstation installed. The Linux VM uses a NAT network.

item.title: Apache_Kafka_Architecture_Topology
item.description: This article will describe the how the Apache Kafka work with components Kafka and components： Apache kafka is distributed event-streaming engine. It was designed by C/S(Client/Server) archtecture. Client means kafka producer and kafka consumer, which function include: Kafka producer and kafka consumer. Server means kafka broker, which function include: store data; cluster of computers; can also integrate with other systems. Kafka Server: Data written by producers is stored and organized via topics.

item.title: [English] Creating a New Theme
item.description: Introduction This tutorial will show you how to create a simple theme in Hugo. I assume that you are familiar with HTML, the bash command line, and that you are comfortable using Markdown to format content. I’ll explain how Hugo uses templates and how you can organize your templates to create a theme. I won’t cover using CSS to style your theme. We’ll start with creating a new site with a very basic template.
